scenes.summary: You and Perlica meet Si and Zhuang Fangyi at the Reception Room. All three of them ask you to head to a place designated by Si to treat the injury you suffered from the Æther.

lines.text: During our battle against Alleikhreos, the Æther left a mark on you.
Originium can disrupt the Æther, but it works both ways. Your body is already weak, it can't take this constant reaction.
Why deny us, the right of survival? Why disown us, the hearth of your own?
My Maker is ... only ... deceived by her...
Shut your trap, stone head!
Do we have to do this again? The Æther is turning your brain into porridge! Stop acting tough!
Ardashir has gone missing. The "Exiles" wouldn't give up either. We must be ready for a new crisis.
lines.textM: Ardashir has gone missing. The "Exiles" won't give up either. We must be ready for a new crisis.

lines.text: As for Endfield, the other operators and I are here. Don't worry, Endmin.
I still have things to deal with, so I'll take my leave... But don't you dare be late!
It's been decided. We're hauling you there whether you like it or not.
If she has made up her mind, nothing can change her decision...
Tianshi Zhuang? Rebuilding the exclusion zone must be hard work. What brings you here?
She hopes you can set off right now, and get treated at a designated location.
The Endmin leaving Dijiang to receive treatment not provided by Endfield... There is no precedent for this.
That is why I made this trip. I have to verify your status and vouch for Lady Si.
Is all this trouble necessary?
Why don't you just listen to the ladies? Do I have to step in and make you?
You...
I came just to pay you a visit... Endmin, you look even more wasted away than before.
Supervisor Perlica, it seems we have no choice but to follow Lady Si's instructions.
Si? Her instructions?
Endmin, remember back at the Yinglung Pass? Lady Si said she'd help treat your injuries.
The Big Three are following the Band Accord as we speak. Defense protocols have been initiated, giving the Civilization Band the readiness it needs.

scenes.summary: Zhuang Fangyi sorts out the situation for you. She shares some info about Si.

lines.text: Endmin, Lady Si must have her reasons for making this arrangement.
We've successfully defeated Nefarith and the Bonekrushers, foiling their schemes on Wuling City and the Very Large Rift.
As a Feranmut Proxy, Lady Si rarely makes public appearances. She usually communicates with HAS through special liaisons.
Her sudden presence to support us at Yinglung Pass is probably due to your presence, Endmin.
That being said, Lady Si is never absent in times of need. You can always trust her, both professionally and personally.
I hope it works out, Endmin.
The North Wuling Exclusion Zone has also been reclaimed. We can finally rebuild our lost home.
You should take this opportunity to heal up. That will put my ... our worries to rest.

options: Can you help me sort this out clearly?
What do you know about Si?

r: Can you help me sort this out clearly?
What do you know about Si?

scenes.summary: Perlica is deeply worried about your condition. She insists that you go alone to receive treatment, just as Si has requested.

lines.text: Endmin, does your head still hurt? The suppressor gave very troubling readings just then.
I understand. You don't want to make us worried.
No. It's what Lady Si requested. She did not explain why.
Feranmut power is not like Originium Arts. There are certain principles known only to the proxies.
I have faith in Lady Si. The two of you have been friends for many, many years.
Endmin, please cooperate and let her treat you.
Sorry, Perlica...
But your body can no longer afford to delay treatment. Conventional measures have had little effect. Lady Si's solution might work.
Wait. You're not coming with me?
...Okay.
Endmin, I'll be waiting for you on Dijiang.

scenes.summary: You successfully rendezvous with Si in the hills and learn that your injuries will be treated in a painting, a place that happens to be Si's home.

lines.text: I thought you'd get lost, but you made it here pretty quickly.
Good. You came alone. I'm glad both you and that little supervisor listened.
Where are we, exactly?
Talos-II may be large, but only a few places in this world can treat your injuries. This is my home. Goes without saying.
Your home? Does that mean the front door...
It's a painting, can't you tell?
So you live in a painting?
Mmhmm. Think about it. How long did it take to build Wuling City?
But a painted world works independently. I just need a suitable site to hang the painting.
Living far away keeps annoying people at bay. And I can monitor the Exclusion Zone for Hongshan. I call this a brilliant idea.
Come on. Hop on. Let me show you what it looks like inside the painting!
But it's as tall as a mountain ... and things inside are moving?

options: That looks like a sheet of canvas...
I can't really tell what that is...
Truly brilliant. It solves so many problems.
The proxy works in esoteric ways.

scenes.summary: A "Dijiang" is parked at a mountain peak within the painting. Si tells you to reach this "Dijiang" to complete your treatment. However, she must take you to another place to rest before you do so.

lines.text: Watch closely. Talos-II may be vast, but nowhere else will you find anything like this.
This painting actually contains a whole mountain. And that thing above the peak. Isn't it...?
Hm. You're not seeing things. That's indeed "Dijiang".
Well, too bad I couldn't achieve a full-size depiction. And it's a vertical hanging scroll. The work is not quite perfect.
Dijiang is your headquarter. You're the reason why I painted it.
We'll do some hiking, reach the peak, and let that "Dijiang" treat your injury.
There's a reason behind this arrangement. You'll know afterwards.
Let's go. First we'll find you somewhere to rest.
Sounds complicated. Why don't we skip directly to the treatment?
What a wondrous channel. The watery ink feels alive...
What was that creature?
Just like the butterflies you saw at the Marker Stone. It's a simple doodle.
An Ink Spirit?
An entire world, real or imagined, given life by my brush.
It's magnificent. But ... why did you paint "Dijiang" at the mountain peak?
Mm... Prepare yourself. Once inside, everything in the painted world will be real to you. You can see them, and you can touch them.

scenes.summary: You arrive at Si's inn at the foot of the mountain. An idling worker of the inn seems to recognize you.

lines.text: Lazy bum! The sun is up already!
Yeah, yeah, sure. The sun never sets here anyway…
Oh dear, milady! You should've let us know you were coming back?
There're no guests at the inn, and I was just taking a break. Surely this doesn't count as slacking off, right?
Enough. Can't you see we have a guest here?
Dark hair... Endfield... This is the one you kept talking about... Mmm, what's up with the mask...?
Quit yammering. Get the business running, now!

scenes.summary: Si introduces you to the inn assistants, each with a distinct personality. She also arranges a room for you on the second floor.

lines.text: Hmph. Now this is a proper inn.
Well, well, someone's being observant...
It adds life. The scene here is beautiful. I don't want it going to waste.
Speed Dasher works in the kitchen, but he's super slow. Watching him work is pure torture.
(Hmhmph)
"Witty" is the oldest assistant. It's one of the mountain Ink Spirits that didn't come from my brush.
The other three assistants don't look like random doodles to me...
Of course not. I can't have random doodles help run my inn.
Real or imagined... Does it really matter?
Anyway, while you are here, feel free to ask them for anything.
Take a look around first, then come find me at the second floor. I'll show you to your room.
Why build an inn here?
These guests... They kinda look like your doodles...
So are they actual people, or Ink Spirits you painted based on real people?
Those are the inn assistants... You've met Job Rusher, our receptionist. Little sneak slacks off whenever she can.
Loud Speaker takes the orders. Despite all these years, she's still very shy and can't talk to strangers.
Forgot which day it was, but I woke up seeing a bunch of these little critters around me. I just found them really cute. They also give me a sense of closeness.
"Witty" was the smartest of them all, so I've kept it close to me ever since.
T-today is a special case! We usually have a lot more guests than this.

scenes.summary: The inn assistant, "Job Rusher", says you used to frequent the inn.

lines.text: Back in the courtyard, you actually recognized me, right?
Haha. You found out.
Ten years ago, you were a regular at the inn.
Every time you came by, our Lady would get really excited, and the inn would be buzzing with energy.
And I mean real excitement, not the kind whipped up with her little trick.
Oh dear, I just can't keep secrets! Our Lady forbids us to tell you about the past!
Sorry, patron! I gotta get back to work!
Can you tell me more?

scenes.summary: Si takes you to your old room. She tells you that time flows differently in the Painted World. To get ready for treatment, you should follow the arrangements and get some proper rest.

lines.text: Here. Your room. If you're missing anything, just ask the assistants — What are you looking at?
So you came upstairs just to clean my...
S-stop overthinking it! I have standards, okay? No innkeeper wants to deal with guest complaints.
This room seems like it hasn't been used for quite a while...
It's been set aside for you. I don't mind leaving it empty.
Back in those days...
You just need to know this is my best room, and I've kept it empty for ten years ... which costs me quite a fortune...
Don't worry, I'll give you the bills later.
You actually brought in most of the books on the shelves. I've left them untouched.
Hmph. I don't think seeing your old things will jog your memory.
It's okay. I'm not upset. Anyway, the room is clean. Go ahead and grab some sleep.
Grab some sleep? I thought we were all set for hiking up the mountain.
The sooner we set off, the quicker I can get my treatment.
I control time inside the painting. None of your official business will get delayed!
The Æther is tearing your body and mind apart. Treating such injuries won't be easy!
You need to follow every single instruction I give. Got it?
You're being stubborn again... Look, you need some proper sleep. It's the best way to prepare for your treatment.
I'll tell the help downstairs to quiet down.
Something on my nose? Ah... I was in too much of a rush when I was cleaning…
Still smelling dust? But I already opened the windows to aerate the room...
I'm very sorry...
You also loaded the room with all kinds of stuff. Look around. Everything should still be there.
*Sigh*. Talking about it won't bring back your memories.

options: Did someone dust this room a short while ago?
Back then, what were my reasons for visiting?
What about the things in the room?

scenes.summary: You take Si's advice and rest for a while.

lines.text: The bed has been meticulously tidied up and gives off a soothing vibe.
None of this felt foreign to you.
(The painted world is very different from reality. Si said she can control its time. Maybe I should take her word for it...)
(Alright. I'll just follow her advice and rest for a bit...)

scenes.summary: You see Si chasing a mysterious golden-haired man out of the inn. She then temporarily sets your treatment aside and orders you to help manage the inn.

lines.text: Trespassers will be doused with hot tea! Trespassers will be doused with hot tea!
Bad excuses deserve hot tea! Bad excuses deserve hot tea!
Let's be civil and serve the tea properly...
There are others who can enter your painting?
Hmph. Mister brighthair is just an errand boy for Hongshan. He's not that capable!
Yeah. I tried living really far away, but Hongshan keeps sending people over ... just to say hello or borrow my stuff...
And since we go back for quite a while, it'd be rude of me to shut my door in their faces...
Hongshan...
Prior to this day, I've only led your stray burdenbeasts back to their pens. I have not set foot in your inn.
Lady Si, I am only acting on command. Since you have returned, we should proceed as agreed and start —
He's not your concern. Just some troublemaker making things hard for my inn.
Our troublemaker seemed rather polite.
He looked ... special, compared to the others in the painting.
Nonsense. I'll never paint an annoying guy like him.
Oh, right. I've got an urgent errand to deal with. You can keep exploring the inn. Once I'm done, I'll take you up the mountain.
"Job Rusher"...
Take good care of her. Remember, I don't want to find you slacking or running your mouth.
lines.textM: Take good care of him. Remember, I don't want to find you slacking or running your mouth.

lines.text: Heard you loud and clear... Oh, milady, I thought you got a job to rush to?
Hmm?
I'll show our patron around the backyard...
Follow me, dear patron.

options: Was that one an Ink Spirit as well?

scenes.summary: "Speed Dasher" tells you that Si is the benefactor of every inn assistant.

lines.text: My dear patron! The mountain is a trove of game and herbs. I'm treating you to a proper welcoming feast!
It seems something has happened to you. People say nothing in life is predictable. But they also say your actions determine the outcomes.
And you, dear patron, appear to believe in the second saying.
You three are pretty different from everyone else in the painting...
Haha. I can't say much, but Lady Si is a great benefactor to all three of us. That's why we are her assistants.
As for our origins, our actual names, and whether we're Ink Spirits or not...
It's just as our Lady said: real or imagined, it doesn't really matter.
Life is an arduous journey, and we are all but travelers upon it.
Sorry, but I'm here for treatment of my injuries. I'll take a rain check this time.

scenes.summary: You see the inn assistant "Loud Speaker" trying to soothe "Witty", who seems to have swallowed something it shouldn't have.

lines.text: (Hmhmph)
Ah... I-it's you, dear patron...
I wasn't blaming you. I wasn't, really.
Please, Witty! Stop swallowing things!
"Witty" just swallowed the service bell. I had a hard time getting it to spit the thing out.
(Hmhmph)
Sorry, Witty, swallowing isn't a bad habit. It just gets ink all over the place and makes quite a mess...
Guess I'll ... take my leave now.

scenes.summary: You meet Ye Minghe from Hongshan who claims that he is visiting to help with your treatment. Si decides to delay no longer and starts the hike towards the mountaintop "Dijiang" with you.

lines.text: If Lady Si loses the brush, she'll get pretty upset about that little Ink Spirit. I hope you are not disturbed, Endministrator.
You know me?
Definitely not, milady. We have, by chance, retrieved your brush. I hope it has not been damaged.
You were secretly feeding "Witty" and whispering to my assistants. Do you think you can get away with that?
Mister Minghe said he came here to help, I believe?
I've made arrangements for everything. I don't need his help.
Anyway, time to start hiking.
The brush alone suffices.
Good thing is, you've been quite cooperative so far.
I'll need you to follow my words closely, okay?
My plan was to let you stay in the inn for a bit. But since Ye Minghe has led you here, we don't need to head back anymore.
My apologies. I should have introduced myself sooner... I am Ye Minghe of HAS.
I believe I know you better than most. My presence here was requested by several Tianshi to assist in your treatment.
Then why did Si chase you out of the inn?
Haha. You actually caught me at an awkward moment.
Lady Si likes her peace. She doesn't like being disturbed by envoys. She was just enjoying her reunion with you, and my visit probably got in the way.
I went around looking for you, only to find you here gossiping about me?
The Endministrator's safety is critical to the entirety of the Civilization Band. Hongshan naturally wants an agent on-site.
Hur. I've got young little Zhuang to vouch for me. Is that not good enough for you?
Not quite.
You little...
But since you're ready to take the Endministrator up the mountain, I won't delay you any further.
But should the need arise, I will interfere. Do pardon my intrusions, milady.
Endministrator, it may not be completely pleasant. Allow me to apologize to you as well.
This is the first time I've seen you so frustrated with someone.
The guy's quite the diplomat. Worse, he has the fighting skills to back it up... Such people usually mean trouble, so I just ignore them.
We're not heading back to the inn? Shouldn't we get some hiking gear?
But "Dijiang" is a long climb ahead. To get to your treatment, we may have to endure quite a journey.

scenes.summary: You find a mysterious beast in the backyard.

lines.text: (*Bored snorting*)
(I've never seen a beast like this before...)
(It's saddled... Could it be Si's ride?)
(But she never mentioned it before...)
Did you break out of the stables? Or did you enter the backyard by accident?
(Does not react)
(Shakes her head unhappily)
(Shakes her head impatiently)
Alright, alright, fine. Since you didn't make a mess of things, I'll stay off your back.

scenes.summary: "Job Rusher" explains why Si is hesitant about taking you to the mountains. She is worried about your exhaustion and hopes you can get some proper rest first.

lines.text: "Job Rusher", I think you know why Si made these arrangements.
Well, since it's you asking, she can't really blame me for running my mouth!
*Sigh* it's obvious you're keen to reach the mountaintop. But treating injuries is like running a business. You can't rush things.
Our Lady keeps saying, "That silly dolt probably never took a break after awakening. That means no mountain hiking for now!"
She just wants you to calm your spirit, so you're prepared for the treatment.
Aren't you worried? Si might be mad if she finds out you've told me all this.
Staying in the inn will make you overthink things. Our Lady cares too much, and it's messing with her decisions...
OH NO! The brush ... the brush has escaped!
So what are you doing back here? Go chase it down!
'Cause I was scared. There are so many waregeists out there!
Waregeists...? Are they something like Ink Spirits?
Yes. Inks or things, it doesn't matter. Inanimate objects would start gaining intellect after staying around our Lady for too long.
Our Lady calls them all ... "Apparitions". Just think of them as mountain spirits or imps.
Waregeists are okay if you don't mess with them. But "Witty" is carrying the Lady's brush. They'll be all over it...
Don't worry. I need to talk to Si anyway. I'll get the brush while I'm at it.
Really?! Oh, thank you so much!
You're still injured, my dear patron. Be careful out there.
"Witty" took away our Lady's precious brush!
Besides hall work, we need to take care of the stables and the farms...
Believe in Lady Si's ability. You'll be getting a full recovery, Endmin.
Still here? Are things too noisy for you?
Stop thinking, and just go to sleep.
Go to sleep!
A Stroke Condensed — A Portrait of "You"
